kind: isothermal-px (gas solubility: total pressure over the liquid)

source.citation: T. Tsuji, Y. Shinya, T. Hiaki, N. Itoh, Hydrogen solubility in a chemical hydrogen storage medium, aromatic hydrocarbon, cyclic hydrocarbon, and their mixture for fuel cell systems, Fluid Phase Equilib. 228-229 (2005) 499-503
source.access: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive, free access to the data of Fluid Phase Equilibria
source.tables: ThermoML file: 4th PureOrMixtureData block (hydrogen + toluene; vapour or sublimation pressure, kPa, of the liquid as a function of the liquid mole fraction of hydrogen; constraint T = 303.15 K). Expanded uncertainty of P from nCombExpandUncertValue.
source.transcription: Read from the ThermoML XML with a web-reading tool; two independent readings agreed on every value. The reviewer should compare each row with the XML.

notes: x_H2 is the mole fraction of hydrogen in the liquid; P is the equilibrium (bubble) pressure.
